title: jspsych-fps-lab study config
description: One research study. Load with ?study=<file name without .json>, or in JATOS through the component input {"study": "<id>"} that npm run build:jatos sets.

content_warning.description: Plain text of the first screen. Default: the content warning in AGENTS.md.

consent_html.description: The researchers' consent text (HTML). The list of recorded data and where it goes is added below it.

instructions_html.description: Shown after consent, before the first block. Default: the game controls.

devices.description: Allowed devices. Only desktop (keyboard and mouse; Chromium-based browsers or Firefox) for now. Default: ["desktop"].

fullscreen.description: Play in full screen; leaving it pauses the game. Default: true.

iwad.description: The game data loaded at start (gzipped): the trimmed Freedoom IWAD (npm run build:iwad), whose classic levels are listed in src/paradigms/iwad.json. Development builds also take ?iwad=<name>.wad, e.g. miniwad.wad or freedoom2.wad.

wads.description: Map WADs (PWADs) loaded after the IWAD, from public/wads/manifest.json (npm run build:maps). Their maps replace the IWAD's in the same MAPxx slots.

face.description: Status-bar face: "freedoom" (default, the IWAD's own) or the id of a face built with npm run build:face (faces/<id>, never public). Custom faces need save.target "jatos".

url_params.description: Names of URL query parameters to store with the data (never shown on the page).

completion_url.description: Where participants go after finishing, e.g. back to a recruitment platform.

target.description: download: a JSON file in the browser only; jatos: the lab's JATOS server; datapipe: DataPipe (prepared, not implemented yet).

jatos.description: Fixed UUIDs of the JATOS study, component and batch; re-importing the study updates it in place.

practice.description: Practice block: its trials are marked practice: true in the data.

questionnaires.description: Pages of questions after the last block, in order. Each page has one question type.

type.description: likert: a scale per question (labels); choice: pick one (options); multi_select: pick any (options); text: typed answers.

name.description: Key of the answer in the data; unique in the study.

labels.description: likert only: the scale points, lowest first. Answers are stored as 0-based indexes.

horizontal.description: choice and multi_select only: options in one row.

rows.description: text only: height of the answer box in lines.

paradigm.description: classic: a level of the IWAD; maze, threat-corridor or two-door-bandit: a map of that paradigm from the study's wads. Default classic.

map.description: MAPxx number; for maze, threat-corridor and two-door-bandit trials a slot of such a map in the study's wads.

time_limit.description: Seconds of game time (pauses don't count); at most 15 minutes.

params.description: The paradigm's parameters (src/paradigms/registry.ts); missing ones take their defaults. Only threat-corridor and two-door-bandit have any.

seed.description: Seed of the paradigm's randomness (threat-corridor: delays and spawn spots; two-door-bandit: rewards and drift). Left out: drawn per trial when it starts, and recorded.

hud.description: Status bar and pickup messages; false gives a full-height view. Default true.

automap.description: Tab opens the automap (the 3D view, and so monster visibility, is off while it is open). Default false.

prompt_html.description: Shown over the game until the participant clicks to start.

measures.description: Measure ids, or {id, params}. Default: the paradigm's default measures (classic: all).
